title: Getting started
summary: What this app is for and a friendly order to set things up.

paragraphs.text: Welcome—you are looking at a personal double-entry ledger with budgeting and reporting built in. The idea is simple: you define where money lives (accounts), record what happened (journal entries), and optionally plan ahead (budget plans) without mixing plans into posted history.
If you are setting up for the first time, most people go in this order:

items: Open Settings and set accounting periods—how long each period is and when your books begin.
Skim Account types, then create the Accounts you will actually post to.
Import bank activity on Pending journal entries, or post directly on the Ledger.
Try Budget planning when you want a forward-looking picture that stays separate from the ledger.

paragraphs.text: Whenever you are stuck, look for the ? in the top bar or beside a section. Short tips open in a popup; longer guides live under Help in the menu.
